usedFor: CallRail records calls and texts, and Asana opens a project after “Outbound Call Ends” through “Create Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “Outbound Call Ends” in CallRail, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A finished call becomes a project with a name, owner and dates, so follow-through has a home.

watchOut: “Call Modified” runs on every change to a call, so “Create Project” can open the same project twice.
